$comment: Country names are matched against the names GDELT itself emits, after a deterministic normalisation (lowercase, parentheticals and punctuation removed). This file holds only the leftovers that normalisation cannot reconcile. Names the resolver fails to match are reported in data/health.json rather than guessed, so entries here are added from observed mismatches — never invented up front.
$ucdpNote: UCDP spells some countries its own way — "DR Congo (Zaire)", "Kingdom of eSwatini (Swaziland)" — so its strings are mapped here rather than in code. Historical entities it also carries (South Vietnam, South Yemen, Hyderabad) have no modern FIPS and stay unresolved, which is correct: the conflict is recorded, but there is no present-day country to place it in.
